purpose: Audit a parameter-free source controller defined by alignment of the summed Newtonian field with the inward direction from the baryonic centroid, before reading any galaxy or cluster score.

equation.baryonic_center: x_c=integral rho_b x dV/integral rho_b dV
equation.geometric_limits: A_r=1 for an exactly inward radial field; A_r=0 for tangential or outward fields
equation.gauge_safe_base: solve Laplacian(Phi_base)=S_base with Phi_coh on the Dirichlet boundary
equation.physical_interpretation: a globally inward net field selects the coherent completion even when individual cells cancel; local off-center pulls retain the local field-equation source

numerics.rotation_test: swap x and y axes of the two-center field and compare correspondingly transposed results
numerics.translation_test: translate the compact single source and barycentric center by two native x cells and compare the overlapping field
numerics.explicit_vector_controls: evaluate exact inward radial, outward radial, and tangential vector fields on the primary coordinate grid

selection_rule: Advance the exact barycentric radial-alignment source controller to one separately frozen spent joint screen only if every alignment-bound, explicit-vector-limit, center, single-center, two-center-structure, rotation, translation, resolution, source-identity, endpoint, residual, curl, boundary, hybrid, strong-field, finite, accounting, no-observation, and sealed-target gate passes. No exponent, threshold, angular width, smoothing, offset, multiplier, or fitted physical quantity may be added after this audit.
claim_boundary: P0700 is a numerical and mathematical audit, not an observational test.
The global barycentric direction is nonlocal and is not yet derived from a covariant action or causal evolution equation.
A global center may still be inadequate for merging or strongly multi-center systems even if local alignment varies.
